name: createTypeScriptIndexer

versions.rationale: The phase 1 indexer from ADR 0003. It builds one program over the files in scope and reuses it through oldProgram and a host that hands back unchanged SourceFiles. A per-file cache, keyed by a Merkle hash of each file's import closure, lets unchanged files skip the checker.

docs: Creates an indexer whose program and per-file cache carry over between index calls.
